tools.done: Movements by type (demo), Cheras 1–18 Nov, quantities only: Dispensing 318 (Dispensed, out) · Verified receiving 21 (Received, in) · Transfer in 9 / Transfer out 11 (Transferred net) · Treatment room usage and waste 24 (Adjusted, out) · Stock count and write-off 17 (Adjusted, in or out) · Patient return 4 (Adjusted, in) · Supplier return 8 (Adjusted, out). 412 movements in all. 14 SKUs in this period, 0 not reconciling.

tools.label: How this report counts
tools.done: How this report counts: Closing is the ledger quantity at the end of the last day, not today's live balance. Adjusted includes opening balances, write-offs, supplier returns, treatment room use and waste, and patient returns. Transferred is net: into the branch minus out of it. Quantities are exact to three decimals in the CSV; shown rounded here. Check: Opening plus movements equals Closing for every row. No total row: units differ between SKUs, so they are never added together.

tools.label: Totals and summary
tools.done: Stock value on 20 Nov 2026 (demo): total RM 1,097.48 for 9 medicines · Cost of goods sold RM 5,124.40 · Medicine sales RM 7,980.00 · Gross margin RM 2,855.60 · Losses RM 92.82. Unit costs show up to 4 decimals; values are rounded to sen.

tools.label: How this is counted
tools.done: How this is counted: Weighted average cost per medicine per branch; a purchase receipt moves the average (value before plus the receipt's cost, divided by the quantity before plus what was received). Opening stock enters at the unit cost entered for it. Stock leaving (dispensing, treatment-room use and waste, write-offs, supplier returns, count losses) leaves at the average at that moment. Transfers leave one branch at its average and arrive at the same cost. Purchase order estimates are used when nothing was paid yet, and marked 'Includes an estimate' until that stock is gone. Stock with no cost enters at the current average; with no average yet it is counted apart and named, never valued at zero. Supplier credit notes do not move the average; the difference is shown under Losses.
